context: Adds liveness and readiness health check endpoints for the Kubernetes probes, checking the database and Redis only for readiness.
explanation: Safe to merge. Liveness uses Predicate = _ => false so it never runs a dependency check and just confirms the process can respond, which avoids the pod being killed and restarted because of a slow downstream dependency. Readiness is tagged to include the DB and Redis checks, so the pod is correctly pulled out of the load balancer rotation when a dependency is down. This is the standard ASP.NET Core health check split for orchestrated deployments.
